# Quitting Zyn

> QuittingZyn.com is a dedicated resource providing actionable strategies, timelines, and support for individuals looking to break free from nicotine pouch addiction, anchored by a focused peer-support community.

## Primary Action
- [Join the Telegram Support Group](https://t.me/+SGC4Yrcc2UQyZDZh): Direct link to the community chat for real-time peer accountability, daily check-ins, and shared quitting strategies.
